_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Fantastic Voyage#001.src: Let's go, just you and me! On a grand voyage across the sea!
Fantastic Voyage#001.dst: さあ行こう、君と二人で！海を越える大いなる船旅で！
Fantastic Voyage#001.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#002.src: We'll go in search of a long-lost island, old chap! And here I have the guidance map!
Fantastic Voyage#002.dst: 探しに行くぞ、失われし島を、友よ！道しるべの地図はここにあるのよ！
Fantastic Voyage#002.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#003.src: The map, oh so grand! Why, I have it here in my hand!
Fantastic Voyage#003.dst: この地図の、なんと見事なこと！ほら、この手にしっかりと！
Fantastic Voyage#003.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#004.src: It's a map to a magical place! I sure hope it doesn't vanish without a tra-
Fantastic Voyage#004.dst: 魔法の地への地図なのさ！跡形もなく消えなきゃいいが―
Fantastic Voyage#004.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#005.src: Good grief! That raucous parrot is such a little thief!
Fantastic Voyage#005.dst: なんとまあ！あのやかましいオウム、とんだ泥棒だ、ああ！
Fantastic Voyage#005.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#006.src: If we are to explore the ocean blue, that parrot you surely must pursue!
Fantastic Voyage#006.dst: 青き海へ漕ぎ出すならば、あのオウムを追いかけねば！
Fantastic Voyage#006.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#007.src: Retrieve the map back from the parrot.
Fantastic Voyage#007.dst: オウムから地図を取り返す。

Fantastic Voyage#012.src: I'm doing j-just fine... Just... I'm just fine...
Fantastic Voyage#012.dst: げ、元気です…ただ…元気なだけです…
Fantastic Voyage#012.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#014.dst: じ、実は結構調子いいです。
Fantastic Voyage#014.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#016.dst: よ、よく分かりません…えっと、実は…
Fantastic Voyage#016.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#020.src: Uh... I-I'm sorry, I don't know who you m-mean...
Fantastic Voyage#020.dst: えっと…す、すみません、誰のことか分からなくて…
Fantastic Voyage#020.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#021.dst: 私は、えっと、その、私は、えっと…
Fantastic Voyage#021.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#023.dst: …すみません、わ、分かりません…
Fantastic Voyage#023.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#025.src: L-L-Like a b-bird?! I l-love birds!
Fantastic Voyage#025.dst: と、と、鳥みたいな？！と、鳥大好きです！
Fantastic Voyage#025.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#026.src: I will look for it... Human...
Fantastic Voyage#026.dst: 探してみます…人間さん…
Fantastic Voyage#026.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#027.src: Y-you can count o-on me... I will find the bird.
Fantastic Voyage#027.dst: ま、任せてください…鳥を見つけます。
Fantastic Voyage#027.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#028.src: Welcome, welcome! How can I be of service to you, o' traveler?
Fantastic Voyage#028.dst: ようこそ、ようこそ！何なりとお申し付けを、おお旅人よ！
Fantastic Voyage#028.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#029.src: How can I be of service to you, o' traveler?
Fantastic Voyage#029.dst: 何をしてさしあげようか、おお旅人よ？
Fantastic Voyage#029.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#030.src: Hello... hello! You have said... hello!
Fantastic Voyage#030.dst: やあ…やあ！言いましたね…やあと！
Fantastic Voyage#030.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#031.src: Why, I am glad you asked, though I knew you would, of course!
Fantastic Voyage#031.dst: よくぞ聞いてくれた、もちろん聞くと分かっていたがね！
Fantastic Voyage#031.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#032.src: For you see... I am gifted with foresight, the future's memories come to me like no other!
Fantastic Voyage#032.dst: なにしろ…私には先見の力がある。未来の記憶が、誰よりも鮮明に訪れるのだ！
Fantastic Voyage#032.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#033.src: For the low, low price of [{~} LE], your future will be foretold!
Fantastic Voyage#033.dst: わずか [{~} LE] の格安料金で、未来を占ってしんぜよう！
Fantastic Voyage#033.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#034.src: What do you say? Ha-ha, I ask out of courtesy, for I know what you will choose.
Fantastic Voyage#034.dst: どうするかね？はは、礼儀で聞いたまで。何を選ぶかはもう分かっている。
Fantastic Voyage#034.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#035.src: A wise choice, though expected, o' traveler!
Fantastic Voyage#035.dst: 賢明な選択だ。予想通りだがね、おお旅人よ！
Fantastic Voyage#035.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#036.src: Now... I must consult the spirits...
Fantastic Voyage#036.dst: では…霊にお伺いを立てねば…
Fantastic Voyage#036.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#042.src: Aha! O' traveler! Your fortune is as clear to me as the sky on a very clear day!
Fantastic Voyage#042.dst: ははあ！おお旅人よ！君の運勢は、よく晴れた日の空のように澄み切って見える！
Fantastic Voyage#042.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#045.src: ...will grow a little bit older, very soon!
Fantastic Voyage#045.dst: …もうすぐ、少しだけ歳をとる！
Fantastic Voyage#045.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#049.dst: …足元に気をつけるべきだった！
Fantastic Voyage#049.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#056.src: ...are going to get... a refund? What!? Oh, come on!
Fantastic Voyage#056.dst: …返金を…受ける？何だと！？おい、勘弁してくれ！
Fantastic Voyage#056.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#057.src: I am afraid you do not have enough, o’ traveler! Return with [{~} LE] to hear your fortune!
Fantastic Voyage#057.dst: 残念ながら足りないようだ、おお旅人よ！[{~} LE] を持って出直したまえ！
Fantastic Voyage#057.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#058.src: Relend! Oh, the spirits have much to say of that man...
Fantastic Voyage#058.dst: Relend！おお、あの男について霊たちは多くを語る…
Fantastic Voyage#058.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#059.src: More than most, he has seen... More than perhaps most should...
Fantastic Voyage#059.dst: 彼は多くを見てきた…おそらく、見るべき以上に…
Fantastic Voyage#059.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#060.src: Do not be fooled, o' traveler! Many a map has been snatched from his gnarled grasp...
Fantastic Voyage#060.dst: 騙されるな、おお旅人よ！あの節くれだった手から、幾枚もの地図が奪われてきた…
Fantastic Voyage#060.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#061.src: ...perhaps your fortune shall reveal more! Worth a shot, hey?
Fantastic Voyage#061.dst: …君の運勢がもっと明かすかも！試す価値はあるだろう？
Fantastic Voyage#061.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#062.src: Aha... another one who follows the winged reaper...
Fantastic Voyage#062.dst: ははあ…翼ある死神を追う者がまた一人…
Fantastic Voyage#062.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#063.src: Yes... o' traveler... I have seen the parrot many a time... yes, indeed...
Fantastic Voyage#063.dst: そう…おお旅人よ…あのオウムは幾度も見た…そう、確かに…
Fantastic Voyage#063.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#064.src: Today, however, the wraith flies a unique way, one my eyes have not glimpsed.
Fantastic Voyage#064.dst: だが今日、あの亡霊は見慣れぬ飛び方をする。私の目にも映らなかった道だ。
Fantastic Voyage#064.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#065.src: The keeper of the Tavern by my southern stall-mate will know its whereabouts...
Fantastic Voyage#065.dst: 私の南隣の店のそばにある酒場の主人なら、居場所を知っているだろう…
Fantastic Voyage#065.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#066.dst: …気をつけたまえ、おお旅人よ。
Fantastic Voyage#066.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#067.src: Howdy, welcome to Jo's Tavern. What can I get for ya?
Fantastic Voyage#067.dst: よう、Jo's Tavern へようこそ。何にする？
Fantastic Voyage#067.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#068.src: What can I get for ya?
Fantastic Voyage#068.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#069.src: No worries, let me know if you need anythin'.
Fantastic Voyage#069.dst: 気にすんな、何かあったら言ってくれ。
Fantastic Voyage#069.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#070.src: Oh, me? I'm doing just fine, mate.
Fantastic Voyage#070.dst: 俺か？元気にやってるよ、相棒。
Fantastic Voyage#070.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#071.src: This place is pretty popular among sailors, so we get a decent amount a' traffic for such a small place.
Fantastic Voyage#071.dst: ここは船乗りに人気でな、小さな店にしちゃ客の入りはまずまずだ。
Fantastic Voyage#071.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#072.src: 's the only thing keeping me here, quite honestly. Lots'a crazies in this little town, it's nice to meet some normal folk, ya know?
Fantastic Voyage#072.dst: 正直、それだけが俺をここに留めてる。この町は変人だらけでな、まともな奴に会えるとほっとするんだ。
Fantastic Voyage#072.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#077.dst: …本当にこんなのが好きなのか？
Fantastic Voyage#077.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#079.src: Typical resident here, if you ask me, totally nuts.
Fantastic Voyage#079.dst: ここの住人らしいっちゃらしいが、完全にイカれてる。
Fantastic Voyage#079.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#080.src: 's a weird one for sure, always speakin' in his little rhymes. Somethin's really snapped up there.
Fantastic Voyage#080.dst: 間違いなく変わり者だ。いつも韻を踏んで話しやがる。頭のネジが飛んでるな。
Fantastic Voyage#080.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#081.src: I've had loads a' folk come in here real angry 'bout the guy.
Fantastic Voyage#081.dst: あいつのことでカンカンになって来た奴が大勢いたよ。
Fantastic Voyage#081.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#082.src: 'pparently he takes 'em for joyrides 'round the sea and gets all sorts'a labor out of 'em, then just drops 'em back here.
Fantastic Voyage#082.dst: どうも、人を海の遊覧に連れ出して、あれこれ働かせた挙句、ここに置いて帰るらしい。
Fantastic Voyage#082.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#083.src: Ha! Guess he knows how to get some free work done, I'll give 'im that. Maybe he ain't so insane after all, eh?
Fantastic Voyage#083.dst: ハッ！タダ働きさせる方法は心得てるってわけだ。案外イカれてないのかもな？
Fantastic Voyage#083.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#084.src: ...Oh, you're goin' out with Relend, hey? You sure?
Fantastic Voyage#084.dst: …へえ、Relend と出航するのか？本気か？
Fantastic Voyage#084.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#085.src: You know he's nuts, right mate? Y'not gonna find any treasure or anythin'.
Fantastic Voyage#085.dst: あいつがイカれてるのは知ってるよな、相棒？宝なんて見つからないぞ。
Fantastic Voyage#085.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#086.src: Well, whatever, mate. Yeah, the parrot's out on the patio, to the right of me, last I checked.
Fantastic Voyage#086.dst: まあ、好きにしな、相棒。オウムなら、最後に見た時は俺の右手のテラスにいたぜ。
Fantastic Voyage#086.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#087.src: Have a nice trip, mate, if ya can catch it, that is. Heh...
Fantastic Voyage#087.dst: 良い旅を、相棒。捕まえられたらの話だがな。へへ…
Fantastic Voyage#087.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#089.src: Hey-o, human! What can I do for ya?
Fantastic Voyage#089.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#090.src: What can I do for you?
Fantastic Voyage#090.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#092.src: Oh, you know me, pal, just doin' the rounds.
Fantastic Voyage#092.dst: ああ、いつも通りさ、見回りしてるだけだよ。
Fantastic Voyage#092.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#093.src: Waterin' the pots, starin' at the water, potterin' the sta-
Fantastic Voyage#093.dst: 鉢に水やり、海を眺め、例のブツの世話―
Fantastic Voyage#093.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#095.src: You know what, I’m glad you asked.
Fantastic Voyage#095.dst: いやあ、聞いてくれて嬉しいよ。
Fantastic Voyage#095.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#096.src: Lots of people these days are going crazy for that ‘all-natural, multiple grains, bred ethically’ garbage.
Fantastic Voyage#096.dst: 近頃は「天然素材、多穀物、倫理的栽培」なんてゴミに夢中な奴が多くてな。
Fantastic Voyage#096.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#097.src: Really, I wish some of those nutters sit down and take a good bite of some raw, authentic Rye, or a hearty whole-wheat.
Fantastic Voyage#097.dst: ああいう変人どもには、座って本物の生のライ麦か、しっかりした全粒粉を一口かじってほしいもんだ。
Fantastic Voyage#097.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#098.src: That’s the stuff that puts hairs on your chest, my pappy used to say. Good, strong, proper bread from out in the fields.
Fantastic Voyage#098.dst: 親父がよく言ってた、ああいうのが男を強くするってな。畑から来た、しっかりした、ちゃんとしたパンだ。
Fantastic Voyage#098.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#099.src: We used to be farmers, you know. Out near {p}. WHEW! Glad I moved here though! Not many places serve better rum than good ol’ Jofash!
Fantastic Voyage#099.dst: うちは昔は農家でな。{p} の近くさ。ふう！ここに越してきて良かったよ！Jofash より旨いラムを出す所なんてそうないからな！
Fantastic Voyage#099.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#100.src: Back to the point at hand, though, bread. Man oh man I feel like I could go on forever about this.
Fantastic Voyage#100.dst: まあ本題に戻ろう、パンだ。いやはや、この話ならいつまでも話せる気がするね。
Fantastic Voyage#100.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#101.src: You know what people always miss when talking about bread, the CONSISTENCY! The consistency is consistently the most im-
Fantastic Voyage#101.dst: パンを語る時にみんな見落とすもの、それは「きめ」だ！きめはきめ細かく見るのが一番大…
Fantastic Voyage#101.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#102.src: Oh, haha, ‘consistently,’ didn’t even mean to do that. Heheh...
Fantastic Voyage#102.dst: おっと、はは、「きめ細かく」だって、狙ったわけじゃないんだ。へへ…
Fantastic Voyage#102.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#103.src: Ah, there you are! The ol’ train of thought gets derailed sometimes, you see.
Fantastic Voyage#103.dst: ああ、いたいた！思考の列車が時々脱線しちまうんだよ。
Fantastic Voyage#103.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#104.src: But I can tell that you’re a real enthusiast for bread!
Fantastic Voyage#104.dst: でも、あんたが本物のパン好きなのは分かるぜ！
Fantastic Voyage#104.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#105.src: Back to the topic at hand! Consistency! The consistency is consistently the most important part of any good loaf.
Fantastic Voyage#105.dst: 本題に戻ろう！きめだ！きめはきめ細かく、どんな良いパンでも一番大事な所だ。
Fantastic Voyage#105.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#106.src: Overusin’ so-called “refined” grains is a sure and done way to get runny slop that’s not fit for the pigs.
Fantastic Voyage#106.dst: いわゆる「精製」穀物を使いすぎりゃ、豚にも食わせられないドロドロになるのは確実だ。
Fantastic Voyage#106.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#107.src: Come to think, you shouldn’t feed pigs refined grains anyway. It’s hard on their digestion.
Fantastic Voyage#107.dst: 考えてみりゃ、豚に精製穀物を食わせるのもよくない。消化に悪いんだ。
Fantastic Voyage#107.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#108.src: Of course! Digestion. A topic I’ll get to later!
Fantastic Voyage#108.dst: そうだ！消化。その話はあとでする！
Fantastic Voyage#108.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#109.src: Anyway, whole grains are where the money’s at! I’d swear it on these plants.
Fantastic Voyage#109.dst: とにかく、稼げるのは全粒穀物だ！この草木に誓ってもいい。
Fantastic Voyage#109.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#110.src: What you want is a thick-crusted, chewy loaf that you can savor! Not some frail morsel that collapses under its own weight. Why, the things I’ve seen...
Fantastic Voyage#110.dst: 欲しいのは皮が厚くて噛みごたえがあって、味わえるパンだ！自重で潰れるひ弱なもんじゃない。俺が見てきた代物ときたら…
Fantastic Voyage#110.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#111.src: In particular, have you seen some of the scraps sold at {p}? Ridiculous!
Fantastic Voyage#111.dst: 特に、{p} で売ってるクズを見たことあるか？ばかげてる！
Fantastic Voyage#111.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#112.src: I’ll let you in on a little secret. The Sky’s Kitchen is great and all, but what passes for bread there is intolerable. No substance at all!
Fantastic Voyage#112.dst: ちょっと秘密を教えよう。Sky's Kitchen は確かに良い店だが、あそこのパンと呼ばれる物は我慢ならん。中身がまるでない！
Fantastic Voyage#112.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#113.src: What you’ll want to do is get it straight from the fields, right from the soil! Well, not literally, but from the countryside! Leave breadmakin’ to those who’ve been workin’ with grain before they could walk on two legs!
Fantastic Voyage#113.dst: やるべきは畑から直接、土から直接手に入れることだ！まあ文字通りじゃないが、田舎からな！パン作りは、二本足で歩く前から穀物に触れてきた連中に任せな！
Fantastic Voyage#113.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#114.src: Heck, I bet even I could do better than those snobby sauciers.
Fantastic Voyage#114.dst: ちくしょう、あのお高くとまったソース職人より俺の方がうまく作れるね。
Fantastic Voyage#114.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#115.src: Right. Digestion. The fiber in whole-grain bread is a lifesaver.
Fantastic Voyage#115.dst: そうだ。消化。全粒パンの食物繊維は命の恩人だ。
Fantastic Voyage#115.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#116.src: Did you know that whole-grain bread has four times the fiber of white bread? Now you do!
Fantastic Voyage#116.dst: 全粒パンには白パンの四倍の食物繊維があるって知ってたか？これで知ったな！
Fantastic Voyage#116.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#117.src: Helps keep you full and fit. Want to avoid lookin’ like a loaf of white bread yourself? Fiber’s your man.
Fantastic Voyage#117.dst: 腹持ちが良くて体も締まる。自分が白パンみたいな見た目になるのは嫌だろ？繊維に任せな。
Fantastic Voyage#117.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#118.src: Nothin’ beats a rich, fresh-ground fresh-baked loaf with a slab of flat-iron steak. Red meat and fiber make a real man, as my pappy once said.
Fantastic Voyage#118.dst: 挽きたて焼きたての濃厚なパンに、分厚いステーキ。これに勝るものはない。赤身肉と繊維が真の男を作る、って親父が言ってた。
Fantastic Voyage#118.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#119.src: Oh, how time flies. Where was I? Right, white bread.
Fantastic Voyage#119.dst: おっと、時間が経つのは早いな。どこまで話した？そう、白パンだ。
Fantastic Voyage#119.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#120.src: That stuff’s poison, I tell you! Not a lick of nutritional value!
Fantastic Voyage#120.dst: あれは毒だぜ、ほんと！栄養価なんてこれっぽっちもない！
Fantastic Voyage#120.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#121.src: It’s more milk and sugar than bread! Hardly somethin’ you’d want to eat, never mind something for which you’d pay extra!
Fantastic Voyage#121.dst: パンというより牛乳と砂糖だ！食べたい物じゃないし、ましてや余分に金を払う物じゃない！
Fantastic Voyage#121.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#122.src: Those hawkers can pretend that it’s an upper-crust good all they want, but we all know that it’s just a waste of dough.
Fantastic Voyage#122.dst: 物売りどもは上流の品だと好きに装えばいい。だがみんな知ってる、ただの生地と金の無駄だってな。
Fantastic Voyage#122.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#123.src: Heheh, I did it again! Sorry, sorry, I’ll get the train back on track. Heh...
Fantastic Voyage#123.dst: へへ、またやっちまった！悪い悪い、列車を線路に戻すよ。へへ…
Fantastic Voyage#123.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#124.src: Blendin' grains? Why jumble the flavors and textures? Just make two loaves of bread instead of one! Or several, if we're talkin' about more than two types of grain.
Fantastic Voyage#124.dst: 穀物を混ぜる？なんで味や食感をごちゃ混ぜにする？一つじゃなく二つパンを焼けばいい！穀物が二種類より多いなら、何個でも。
Fantastic Voyage#124.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#125.src: Say, that reminds me! Bread’s probably the most versatile food. You can make it from just about any type of grain.
Fantastic Voyage#125.dst: そういや思い出した！パンはたぶん一番万能な食べ物だ。ほぼどんな穀物からでも作れる。
Fantastic Voyage#125.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#126.src: But just because you can doesn’t mean that you should. Who could stomach somethin’ like “Oatmeal-Bran Fusion Delight”? WHO WOULD EVEN MAKE BREAD OUT OF OATS?!
Fantastic Voyage#126.dst: でも作れるからって作るべきとは限らない。「オーツ麦ふすま融合デライト」なんて誰が食える？オーツ麦でパンを作る奴がどこにいる？！
Fantastic Voyage#126.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#127.src: Just a waste of food, in my opinion. Sure, it may be like the hottest new culinary sensation now, but it’ll die out like any other idiotic fad in just days. I’m positive that nobody’s eatin’ it for the taste, that’s for sure. Like “Seven Colors of the Grainbow,” or “Hearty Hemp-tastic,” or...
Fantastic Voyage#127.dst: 俺に言わせりゃ食べ物の無駄だ。今は料理界の最新流行かもしれんが、他のくだらない流行と同じで数日で廃れる。味で食ってる奴なんていないのは確かだ。「七色のコク虹」とか「ヘンプたっぷりヘルシー」とか…
Fantastic Voyage#127.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#128.src: ...and don’t get me started on “Pain au {p}”! But really, Oatmeal-Bran Fusion Delight is among the worst. Oh! That reminds me about a better use for oats.
Fantastic Voyage#128.dst: …「パン・オ・{p}」なんて言い出したらきりがない！だが本当に、オーツ麦ふすま融合デライトは最悪の部類だ。お！オーツ麦のもっといい使い道を思い出した。
Fantastic Voyage#128.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#129.src: If you want to avoid bein’ three sheets to the wind after a busy night of Jofash Rum, then eat a hearty bowl of oatmeal.
Fantastic Voyage#129.dst: Jofash ラムで忙しい夜を過ごした後、べろべろになりたくなきゃ、オートミールをたっぷり一杯食え。
Fantastic Voyage#129.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#130.src: Sounds crazy, I know. But it actually works. Take it from me; I’ve tried it!
Fantastic Voyage#130.dst: 妙に聞こえるだろ。でも本当に効くんだ。俺が試したから確かだ！
Fantastic Voyage#130.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#131.src: While anythin’ made of grain helps, oats are particularly good at this.
Fantastic Voyage#131.dst: 穀物でできた物なら何でも効くが、特にオーツ麦がいい。
Fantastic Voyage#131.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#132.src: And I’d bet my bread that you’d rather eat oatmeal than Oatmeal-Bran Fusion Delight, whatever that’s supposed to be.
Fantastic Voyage#132.dst: それに、あんたもオーツ麦ふすま融合デライトなんて謎の物より、オートミールの方がいいに決まってる。
Fantastic Voyage#132.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#133.src: Though, it seems like you can’t just get a good loaf of bread nearby. Sure, there’s sailin’ biscuits, but that hardly qualifies!
Fantastic Voyage#133.dst: とはいえ、この辺じゃまともなパンが手に入らないみたいだ。航海用ビスケットはあるが、あれはパンと呼べん！
Fantastic Voyage#133.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#134.src: I can’t stomach the fancy stuff, so I just make my own. Not only is it cheaper, but it also tastes much better.
Fantastic Voyage#134.dst: しゃれた物は食えないから、自分で作ってる。安いだけじゃなく、味もずっといい。
Fantastic Voyage#134.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#135.src: It isn’t too difficult. Besides the obvious, you’ll just need some salt and yeast. Grab something to write with, y’hear? Take some notes!
Fantastic Voyage#135.dst: そんなに難しくない。当然の物のほかに、塩と酵母が要るだけだ。何か書く物を用意しな、いいか？メモを取れ！
Fantastic Voyage#135.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#136.src: Ready? Right, let’s get started! The less ingredients you use, the closer you’ll be to makin’ a real loaf! Not the wannabe poundcakes eaten by wannabe spendthrifts.
Fantastic Voyage#136.dst: 準備はいいか？よし、始めよう！材料が少ないほど本物のパンに近づく！見栄っ張りの浪費家気取りが食う、パウンドケーキ気取りじゃないぞ。
Fantastic Voyage#136.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#137.src: There’s a common misconception that you need sugar for the yeast to start risin’. Not true!
Fantastic Voyage#137.dst: 酵母が膨らむには砂糖が要るってよくある誤解がある。違う！
Fantastic Voyage#137.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#138.src: Give it some time, and bread without sugar will rise just as well. If you want somethin’ good, you need to put in the time and effort for it!
Fantastic Voyage#138.dst: 時間をかけりゃ、砂糖なしでもちゃんと膨らむ。良い物が欲しけりゃ、時間と手間をかけなきゃな！
Fantastic Voyage#138.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#139.src: Get it right, and you’ll have the perfect taste and texture for nothin’ more than a few hours of your time!
Fantastic Voyage#139.dst: うまくやれば、数時間を費やすだけで完璧な味と食感が手に入る！
Fantastic Voyage#139.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#140.src: Let me make it clear: you don’t want sugar in your bread. It’ll do a number on its taste and your teeth.
Fantastic Voyage#140.dst: はっきり言っとく。パンに砂糖は要らない。味も歯もやられちまう。
Fantastic Voyage#140.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#141.src: I’ll cover the taste first. The sugar fights with the raw, savory flavors of an otherwise respectable loaf of bread.
Fantastic Voyage#141.dst: まず味の話だ。砂糖は、本来立派なパンの素朴で香ばしい風味とケンカする。
Fantastic Voyage#141.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#142.src: It also fights with your teeth. Bread’s quite sticky as it is, and the sugar doesn’t do it any favors.
Fantastic Voyage#142.dst: 歯ともケンカする。パンはただでさえベタつくのに、砂糖は余計悪くする。
Fantastic Voyage#142.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#143.src: Why, I can still remember the time that I got a cavity. Cried my eyes out, I did.
Fantastic Voyage#143.dst: いやあ、虫歯になった時のことは今でも覚えてる。泣きはらしたもんさ。
Fantastic Voyage#143.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#144.src: Eventually, my pappy had enough, and he went for the ol’ string-on-a-doorknob trick. He got me good there, though it took him a few tries.
Fantastic Voyage#144.dst: とうとう親父が我慢できなくなって、ドアノブに糸を結ぶ例の手を使った。何回かかかったが、見事に抜いてくれた。
Fantastic Voyage#144.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#145.src: Ah, it seems like I got distracted. Back to the topic at hand.
Fantastic Voyage#145.dst: ああ、気が散っちまったみたいだ。本題に戻ろう。
Fantastic Voyage#145.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#146.src: You aren’t goin’ to get quite as much of an effect on your digestion than coarse-ground whole-grain bread. It keeps most of the fiber intact, after all.
Fantastic Voyage#146.dst: 粗挽きの全粒パンほど消化への効果は得られない。なにしろ繊維のほとんどがそのまま残るからな。
Fantastic Voyage#146.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#147.src: You know how fruit juice contains next to no fiber because none of it goes into the juice? It’s the same deal with white bread.
Fantastic Voyage#147.dst: 果汁には繊維がほとんど入ってないだろ、ジュースに入らないから。白パンも同じことだ。
Fantastic Voyage#147.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#148.src: Fruit juice was banned in my household. As my pappy liked to say, a real man only drinks hard spirits and the sweat runnin’ down his face! Though I wasn’t allowed to have the former, not yet at least! Heheh! So I drank milk instead.
Fantastic Voyage#148.dst: うちじゃ果汁は禁止だった。親父いわく、真の男が飲むのは強い酒と顔を伝う汗だけ！まあ前者はまだ許されてなかったがね！へへ！だから代わりに牛乳を飲んだ。
Fantastic Voyage#148.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#149.src: Say, if you haven’t done so already, try bread dipped in milk! Go on! There’s nothin’ quite like it. Don’t accidentally drop the bread into the milk, of course.
Fantastic Voyage#149.dst: そうだ、まだなら牛乳に浸したパンを試してみな！ほら！あれに勝るものはない。もちろんパンを牛乳に落とすなよ。
Fantastic Voyage#149.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#150.src: You’ll end up with a bloated mess with the consistency of a sponge. And you should know by now that consistency is everythin’!
Fantastic Voyage#150.dst: スポンジみたいな、ふやけたブヨブヨになる。もう分かったろ、きめが全てだって！
Fantastic Voyage#150.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#151.src: While we’re on the subject of milk, do you know some folks can’t drink it? Oh, yes, they can try, but sooner or later their belly will protest.
Fantastic Voyage#151.dst: 牛乳といえば、飲めない人がいるって知ってるか？ああ、試すのは勝手だが、遅かれ早かれ腹が抗議する。
Fantastic Voyage#151.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#152.src: It’s the same deal with bread! Stick with whole-grain, nothin’ added. That way, you don’t have to worry about surprise milk appearances and whatnot.
Fantastic Voyage#152.dst: パンも同じだ！全粒のまま、何も足すな。そうすりゃ牛乳がひょっこり入ってる心配もない。
Fantastic Voyage#152.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#153.src: You got that? Let me know when you’re ready for more. Say, you know what? I oughta talk a bit slower to help you digest what I’m sayin’. Oh! “Digest”! I did it again! Heheh...
Fantastic Voyage#153.dst: 分かったか？続きを聞く気になったら言ってくれ。そうだ、話を消化しやすいように、もう少しゆっくり話すべきかな。お！「消化」！またやっちまった！へへ…
Fantastic Voyage#153.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#154.src: Right, then, somethin’ that really peeves me is people who use bakin’ powder. What’s wrong with some good ol’ yeast?
Fantastic Voyage#154.dst: さて、本当に腹が立つのはベーキングパウダーを使う連中だ。昔ながらの酵母の何が悪い？
Fantastic Voyage#154.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#155.src: Too little of it, and it’ll go plum flat in the oven. Just a little too much of it, and your bread’s going to be as bitter as wormwood!
Fantastic Voyage#155.dst: 少なすぎりゃオーブンでぺちゃんこ。ほんの少し多すぎりゃ、パンはニガヨモギみたいに苦くなる！
Fantastic Voyage#155.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#156.src: The only way to get a size that’s just right is the long way! Wait until the yeast works its magic, and bake it right as it reaches its good size.
Fantastic Voyage#156.dst: ちょうどいい大きさにする唯一の方法は、手間をかけることだ！酵母が魔法をかけるのを待ち、いい大きさになったらすぐ焼け。
Fantastic Voyage#156.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#157.src: There’s also nothin’ quite like the smell of yeast as it causes the dough to rise! Works up quite the appetite, it does.
Fantastic Voyage#157.dst: それに生地を膨らませる酵母の香りに勝るものはない！食欲がそそられるんだ、ほんと。
Fantastic Voyage#157.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#158.src: Some people put the cart before the horse and think that yeast works like bakin’ powder. Try that, and you’ll end up with scorchin’-hot bricks in your oven.
Fantastic Voyage#158.dst: 本末転倒で、酵母がベーキングパウダーと同じ働きをすると思ってる奴もいる。そんなことしたら、オーブンに焼けた煉瓦ができるだけだ。
Fantastic Voyage#158.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#159.src: No, you have to do it right, and doin’ it right means leavin’ some of the work to the yeast.
Fantastic Voyage#159.dst: 違う、ちゃんとやるんだ。ちゃんとやるってのは、仕事の一部を酵母に任せるってことだ。
Fantastic Voyage#159.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#160.src: Unless you like flat breads. I can’t see why anyone would, though. Bread’s supposed to be puffy and chewy, not some dough jerky!
Fantastic Voyage#160.dst: 平たいパンが好きなら別だが。そんな奴の気が知れないね。パンはふっくらもちもちであるべきで、生地のジャーキーじゃない！
Fantastic Voyage#160.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#161.src: Though that may not be the case for other pastries. For one, I’ve never once heard of a pie with a chewy crust.
Fantastic Voyage#161.dst: 他の焼き菓子は違うかもしれんがな。例えば、もちもちの皮のパイなんて一度も聞いたことがない。
Fantastic Voyage#161.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#162.src: Really, the beauty in bread lies with it’s simplicity! No complicated steps, no chances for the dough to rebel. Certainly not as fickle as somethin’ like a cream puff.
Fantastic Voyage#162.dst: 本当に、パンの美しさは素朴さにある！複雑な工程もなく、生地が反抗する余地もない。シュークリームみたいな気まぐれな物とは大違いだ。
Fantastic Voyage#162.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#163.src: If you treat the dough with respect, the bread will respect you in turn. It’s simple stuff, really! No finnickin’ around with stiff peaks, or needin’ half a dozen bowls to mix in, or getting a flaky dough just right, or...
Fantastic Voyage#163.dst: 生地に敬意を払えば、パンも敬意を返してくれる。単純な話だ！角が立つまで泡立てたり、ボウルを半ダースも使ったり、パイ生地をちょうどよくしたり、そういう面倒は…
Fantastic Voyage#163.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#164.src: ...and not to mention that just about everythin’ needs butter in some shape or form! Really, what’s with it? It’s not like the stuff grows on trees!
Fantastic Voyage#164.dst: …それに、ほぼ何にでも何かしらの形でバターが要るときた！一体何なんだ？木に生えてるわけじゃないんだぞ！
Fantastic Voyage#164.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#165.src: Makin’ the pastry shiny. Makin’ it taste rich. Makin’ the dough thick. There’s no end to it! Bread’s so much simpler to handle.
Fantastic Voyage#165.dst: 菓子をツヤツヤに。味を濃厚に。生地を厚く。きりがない！パンの方がずっと扱いやすい。
Fantastic Voyage#165.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#166.src: Though some people insist upon puttin’ butter in the bread. Not just on it, but in it! There’s more butter than bread at that point!
Fantastic Voyage#166.dst: なのにパンにバターを入れると言い張る奴がいる。上に塗るんじゃなく、中にだ！もうパンよりバターの方が多い！
Fantastic Voyage#166.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#167.src: I don’t have anythin’ against butter itself, mind you. It’s great on toast! Just I think it oughta stay on the toast rather than in it.
Fantastic Voyage#167.dst: 言っとくが、バター自体に恨みはない。トーストに塗ると最高だ！ただ、中じゃなく上にいるべきだと思うんだ。
Fantastic Voyage#167.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#168.src: Not to mention that there’s a time, place, and occasion for it. If you put butter on everythin’, you’re goin’ to get sick of it real quickly. Eat it in moderation! Your tongue and your emerald pouch will thank you.
Fantastic Voyage#168.dst: それに、時と場所と場合ってものがある。何にでもバターを塗ってたら、すぐ飽きちまう。ほどほどにしろ！舌もエメラルド袋も感謝するぞ。
Fantastic Voyage#168.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#169.src: Of course, there’s always margarine, but why settle for somethin’ inferior? You shouldn’t settle for anythin’ less than the quality you’d expect from your bread!
Fantastic Voyage#169.dst: もちろんマーガリンって手もあるが、なんで劣る物で妥協する？パンに求める品質に満たない物で妥協しちゃいけない！
Fantastic Voyage#169.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#170.src: Though, now that I look at it, bread does get a reputation for bein’ a breakfast food. That’s ridiculous! It’s got a place in every meal of the day!
Fantastic Voyage#170.dst: とはいえ、パンは朝食の食べ物だと思われがちだ。ばかげてる！一日のどの食事にも居場所があるんだ！
Fantastic Voyage#170.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#171.src: Sandwiches? They’ve got bread in ‘em. Casseroles? Any respectable one has it as a shell. Breadsticks? It’s in the name for cryin’ out loud!
Fantastic Voyage#171.dst: サンドイッチ？パンが入ってる。キャセロール？まともな物ならパンを器にする。ブレッドスティック？名前にあるだろ、まったく！
Fantastic Voyage#171.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#172.src: Done right, and it’s also great as a side. I already mentioned having a fresh-ground fresh-baked loaf of whole-grain with a slab of flat-iron steak, but really, a well-sliced loaf and some dippin’ butter can transform a family dinner into a banquet!
Fantastic Voyage#172.dst: うまく作れば付け合わせにも最高だ。挽きたて焼きたての全粒パンに分厚いステーキって話はもうしたが、きれいに切ったパンと浸すバターがあれば、家族の夕食も宴会に変わる！
Fantastic Voyage#172.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#173.src: They’re almost as versatile as potatoes! Actually, even more so, I’d say!
Fantastic Voyage#173.dst: ジャガイモ並みに万能だ！いや、それ以上だな！
Fantastic Voyage#173.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#174.src: As my pappy liked to say, a real man’s got to earn his daily bread through his own toilin’. As you can see, I’ve taken his advice to heart!
Fantastic Voyage#174.dst: 親父がよく言ってた、真の男は自分の労働で日々のパンを稼がにゃならんってな。見ての通り、その言葉を胸に刻んでる！
Fantastic Voyage#174.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#175.src: ...I feel that I’m missin’ somethin’ important that I wanted to discuss. Hang on for a bit, would you?
Fantastic Voyage#175.dst: …話したかった大事なことを何か忘れてる気がする。ちょっと待ってくれるか？
Fantastic Voyage#175.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#176.src: Ah, of course! I can’t believe that I forgot! I wanted to cover some thoughts about bread consistency.
Fantastic Voyage#176.dst: ああ、そうだ！忘れてたなんて信じられん！パンのきめについて考えを話したかったんだ。
Fantastic Voyage#176.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#177.src: Namely, the two extremes: too chewy, and not chewy enough. I already spoke on hardly chewy bread plenty, but there’s such a thing as too much of a good thing.
Fantastic Voyage#177.dst: つまり二つの極端、噛みごたえがありすぎと、足りなさすぎだ。足りない方はもう散々話したが、過ぎたるは及ばざるが如しってな。
Fantastic Voyage#177.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#178.src: And in this case, bread chewiness is a good thing. You don’t want your bread to be too chewy, got it?
Fantastic Voyage#178.dst: で、この場合、パンの噛みごたえは良い物だ。噛みごたえがありすぎるのはダメ、分かったか？
Fantastic Voyage#178.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#179.src: Too chewy’s a step right towards bread that’s outright rubbery. Your teeth’ll bounce right off it!
Fantastic Voyage#179.dst: 噛みごたえがありすぎると、ゴムみたいなパンへまっしぐらだ。歯が跳ね返されるぞ！
Fantastic Voyage#179.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#180.src: Sure, too much give in the dough’s awkward and sets you up for bitin’ your own tongue, but too firm of a loaf can lead to much of the same.
Fantastic Voyage#180.dst: 確かに柔らかすぎる生地は扱いにくいし舌を噛む原因にもなるが、硬すぎるパンも似たようなもんだ。
Fantastic Voyage#180.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#181.src: They always say never bite off more than you could chew, but you oughta be careful not to bite off any less than that, either!
Fantastic Voyage#181.dst: 噛める以上に頬張るなとよく言うが、噛める量より少なく頬張らないようにも気をつけな！
Fantastic Voyage#181.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#182.src: No, just right and chewy’s what you want. Don’t settle for anything more or less!
Fantastic Voyage#182.dst: いや、ちょうどいい噛みごたえ、それが欲しいもんだ。多くも少なくも妥協するな！
Fantastic Voyage#182.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#183.src: Hmm, come to think. You seem really interested in discussin’ bread with me!
Fantastic Voyage#183.dst: うーん、考えてみりゃ、あんた本当に俺とパンの話がしたいみたいだな！
Fantastic Voyage#183.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#184.src: Lean in for a second, would you? I’ve got somethin’ important to say.
Fantastic Voyage#184.dst: ちょっと顔を寄せてくれるか？大事な話がある。
Fantastic Voyage#184.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#185.src: Listening? Right! Ah, sorry, I didn’t mean to shout in your ear.
Fantastic Voyage#185.dst: 聞いてるか？よし！あ、悪い、耳元で叫ぶつもりはなかった。
Fantastic Voyage#185.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#186.src: You’re just about the only person that I’ve been able to have an honest conversation about bread with.
Fantastic Voyage#186.dst: パンについて本音で話せた相手は、あんたくらいのもんだ。
Fantastic Voyage#186.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#187.src: Usually, bread gets brushed off as some kind of dull fodder. Dismissed as too borin’ and too plain, I tell you! That’s what leads to unnecessary excess as people try to make it into something that it’s not.
Fantastic Voyage#187.dst: 普段、パンはつまらない飼料みたいに扱われる。退屈で地味すぎるって片付けられるんだ！だからみんなパンを別物にしようとして、余計なことをしちまう。
Fantastic Voyage#187.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#188.src: But us? We’re different, we’re visionaries, and we know the truth about what really makes a good loaf!
Fantastic Voyage#188.dst: だが俺たちは？違う、先見の明がある。良いパンを作るものの真実を知ってるんだ！
Fantastic Voyage#188.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#189.src: Tell ‘em off, I say! They can’t follow the thoughts of bread enthusiasts like you and I otherwise!
Fantastic Voyage#189.dst: 言い返してやれ！さもなきゃ、あんたや俺みたいなパン好きの考えにはついて来られない！
Fantastic Voyage#189.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#190.src: Ah! Right, never did I get to answerin’ your question. About my favorite type of bread, that is...
Fantastic Voyage#190.dst: あ！そうだ、まだ質問に答えてなかった。俺の好きなパンの種類、だったな…
Fantastic Voyage#190.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#192.src: Sure, it may be simple, but if you were payin’ any attention at all, you’d know for sure why that’s everythin’ that I’m lookin’ for.
Fantastic Voyage#192.dst: 確かに地味かもしれないが、ちゃんと聞いてたなら、それこそ俺の求める全てだって分かるはずだ。
Fantastic Voyage#192.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#193.src: And that just about sums up the basics! Let me know if you want to hear anythin’ more.
Fantastic Voyage#193.dst: 基本はだいたいこんなところだ！もっと聞きたきゃ言ってくれ。
Fantastic Voyage#193.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#194.src: Let’s continue! Have you ever seen a baker wearin’ a fancy hat? Have you ever wondered how that corresponds to how well they bake bread compared to somethin’ else?
Fantastic Voyage#194.dst: 続けよう！しゃれた帽子をかぶったパン職人を見たことあるか？それがパンを焼く腕と、他の物を焼く腕とでどう関係するか考えたことは？
Fantastic Voyage#194.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#195.src: Hah! That crazy coot, you're chattin' with that feller?
Fantastic Voyage#195.dst: はっ！あのイカれ爺と話してんのか？
Fantastic Voyage#195.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#196.src: He's wack-o, y'know... Singing his songs all day, somethin's not right upstairs.
Fantastic Voyage#196.dst: あいつは頭がおかしいぞ…一日中歌ってばかりで、上の方がまともじゃない。
Fantastic Voyage#196.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#197.src: You do you, buddy, but I'd steer clear.
Fantastic Voyage#197.dst: 好きにしな、でも近寄らない方がいい。
Fantastic Voyage#197.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#198.src: A parrot? You know where you are, right?
Fantastic Voyage#198.dst: オウム？ここがどこか分かってるよな？
Fantastic Voyage#198.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#199.src: I see plenty parrots every day, I don't keep track.
Fantastic Voyage#199.dst: オウムなんて毎日山ほど見る、いちいち覚えちゃいない。
Fantastic Voyage#199.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#200.src: I'll keep an eye or two out for one, though, sound peachy?
Fantastic Voyage#200.dst: まあ一応気にかけておくよ、それでいいか？
Fantastic Voyage#200.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#203.src: IT'S IN T-THE TREE, HERE! IT'S HERE!!!
Fantastic Voyage#203.dst: き、木の上です、ここ！ここにいます！！！
Fantastic Voyage#203.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#206.src: You have the map! Thank you for the assistance!
Fantastic Voyage#206.dst: 地図が戻った！見事な手並みだった！
Fantastic Voyage#206.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#207.src: Now let us set sail, and cover some distance!
Fantastic Voyage#207.dst: さあ帆を上げよう、遠くへ漕ぎ出そう！
Fantastic Voyage#207.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#208.src: I'm sorry, new friend, to be of haste!
Fantastic Voyage#208.dst: すまないね新しき友、急かしてしまうね！
Fantastic Voyage#208.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#209.src: However I sense power in you, and we have no time to waste!
Fantastic Voyage#209.dst: だが君には力を感じる、一刻も無駄にはできぬ！
Fantastic Voyage#209.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#210.src: So off we go, to find an old friend, that would be ideal.
Fantastic Voyage#210.dst: では行こう、旧友を探しに、それが理想の旅路に！
Fantastic Voyage#210.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#211.src: I'll captain the ship up at the steering wheel.
Fantastic Voyage#211.dst: 私は舵輪を握り、船長として舵を取り！
Fantastic Voyage#211.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#212.src: Speak to Captain Relend aboard the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#212.dst: Little Wing に乗る Relend 船長と話す。

Fantastic Voyage#213.src: Welcome aboard, I suppose I can consider you my first mate. Although, it appears we now have a problem on our plate.
Fantastic Voyage#213.dst: ようこそ、君を一等航海士と認めよう。だが困ったことに、問題が起きたようだ。
Fantastic Voyage#213.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#214.src: You see those spikes all around my boat? Well, we're about to ram into them like a goat!
Fantastic Voyage#214.dst: 船の周りの棘が見えるかい？山羊のように突っ込むぞ、今にもほら！
Fantastic Voyage#214.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#215.src: I'd steer around them, but it appears the wheel is all smashed. I need you to craft a new one before we both get splashed!
Fantastic Voyage#215.dst: 避けたいが、舵輪が粉々に砕けてしまった。二人とも水浸しになる前に、新しいのを作ってくれ、さあ！
Fantastic Voyage#215.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#216.src: There's a Crafting Table at the front near all the crates. Now hurry up, else the ocean floor awaits!
Fantastic Voyage#216.dst: 木箱の近く、前方に作業台がある。急ぐんだ、でなきゃ海の底が待っている！
Fantastic Voyage#216.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#217.src: Bring a Wooden Board, a Center Piece, and a String to the Crafting Table.
Fantastic Voyage#217.dst: 木の板、中心部品、糸を作業台に持っていく。

Fantastic Voyage#218.src: Bring the Steering Wheel to Captain Relend.
Fantastic Voyage#218.dst: 舵輪を Relend 船長に渡す。

Fantastic Voyage#219.src: Ah, thank you for helping me in my time of need. Let's maneuver through these spikes at a steady speed!
Fantastic Voyage#219.dst: ああ、困った時に助けてくれてありがとう。棘の間を、一定の速さで抜けてゆこう！
Fantastic Voyage#219.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#220.src: Although, at the last minute, there is something I have to confess. I have never captained a ship with any success.
Fantastic Voyage#220.dst: だが土壇場で、打ち明けねばならぬことがある。船長として成功したことが、一度もないのである。
Fantastic Voyage#220.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#221.src: I think before we get into any real danger, we should turn around. Could you man the wheel and get us back to solid ground?
Fantastic Voyage#221.dst: 本当に危なくなる前に、引き返すべきだと思う。舵を取って、陸まで戻してくれるかい、どうだろう？
Fantastic Voyage#221.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#222.src: Man the wheel of the Little Wing.

Fantastic Voyage#223.src: Now you're the captain, hope the sea's not making you nauseous. Steer this ship, but you'll have to be cautious!
Fantastic Voyage#223.dst: 今や君が船長、船酔いしてないといいが。この船を操るのだ、だが注意を怠るなかれ！
Fantastic Voyage#223.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#224.src: Nice steering, although your maneuvers are a bit brash. Hey, watch out! I think we're about to-
Fantastic Voyage#224.dst: 見事な操舵、少々荒っぽいけれど。おい、気をつけろ！このままでは―
Fantastic Voyage#224.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#225.src: Find Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#225.dst: Little Wing の残骸の中で Relend を見つける。

Fantastic Voyage#226.src: As you can see, my ship has become a shipwreck! Now please help me, I am trapped in the lower deck!
Fantastic Voyage#226.dst: 見ての通り、我が船は難破した！助けてくれ、下の甲板に閉じ込められた！
Fantastic Voyage#226.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#227.src: Amazing work, seems you got below deck rather quickly! You're going to have to get through this wreckage to free me!
Fantastic Voyage#227.dst: 素晴らしい、あっという間に甲板の下へ！この残骸を抜けて、私を助け出してくれ、頼んだぞ！
Fantastic Voyage#227.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#228.src: Wow, so you managed to work your way through after all! Maybe to free me, you can use that cannonball?
Fantastic Voyage#228.dst: おお、ついに通り抜けたね！私を助けるには、あの砲弾を使えるかもね？
Fantastic Voyage#228.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#229.src: Save Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#229.dst: Little Wing の残骸の中で Relend を救出する。

Fantastic Voyage#230.src: Thank you for freeing me, now let's leave this mess! Although, I don't know how to do that, I have not even a guess.
Fantastic Voyage#230.dst: 助けてくれてありがとう、さあこの惨状から出よう！だが方法は分からない、見当もつかぬ、どうしよう。
Fantastic Voyage#230.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#231.src: When the ship crashed, it was buried beneath the sand! But the good news is that we're finally back on land!
Fantastic Voyage#231.dst: 船が墜ちて、砂の下に埋もれてしまった！だが良い知らせは、ついに陸に戻れたことだ！
Fantastic Voyage#231.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#232.src: We should probably get of this place, it feels rather small. Perhaps you can try to break through that weak spot in the wall?
Fantastic Voyage#232.dst: ここを出るべきだろう、どうにも狭くて窮屈だ。壁のあの脆い所を、壊してみてはどうだ？
Fantastic Voyage#232.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#233.dst: 難破した Little Wing から出る。

Fantastic Voyage#234.src: It looks like we're going to be stuck here for a while. Come and speak to me so we can find a way off of this isle!
Fantastic Voyage#234.dst: しばらくここで足止めのようだ。話しかけてくれ、この島を出る方法を探そうじゃないか！
Fantastic Voyage#234.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#235.src: Speak to Relend on the beach.
Fantastic Voyage#235.dst: 浜辺で Relend と話す。

Fantastic Voyage#236.src: Gateway Island... we've finally arrived. I'm just thankful that we survived.
Fantastic Voyage#236.dst: Gateway Island…ついに着いた。生き延びられて、ただ感謝がわいた。
Fantastic Voyage#236.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#237.src: Well, all this adventuring has me hungry for stew. We'll need ingredients, whatever's on the island will have to do.
Fantastic Voyage#237.dst: 冒険続きで、シチューが恋しくなった。材料は島にある物で、何とかするしかなさそうだ。
Fantastic Voyage#237.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#238.src: Meat is definitely something we need to reap, try and get [{~} Raw Mutton] from those sheep.
Fantastic Voyage#238.dst: 肉は絶対に必要だ、狩ってこよう。あの羊から [{~} Raw Mutton] を取ってこよう。
Fantastic Voyage#238.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#239.src: And perhaps you could get [{~} Edible Mushrooms] from the western cave, just make sure not to get the kind that will send me to my grave.
Fantastic Voyage#239.dst: それから西の洞窟で [{~} Edible Mushrooms] を採ってきておくれ。私を墓場に送る種類だけは、採らないでおくれ。
Fantastic Voyage#239.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#240.src: I feel like something is missing from this medley. Oh, how about you get [{~} Coconut] from atop that tree?
Fantastic Voyage#240.dst: このごった煮には何か足りない気がする。そうだ、あの木の上の [{~} Coconut] を取ってきてくれる？
Fantastic Voyage#240.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#241.src: And if you could fetch [{~} Berries], that would just make me merry!
Fantastic Voyage#241.dst: [{~} Berries] もあったなら、心がうきうきするだろうな！
Fantastic Voyage#241.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#242.src: Check your quest book if you ever need a recap. And to make sure you don't get lost, take this map.
Fantastic Voyage#242.dst: おさらいが必要なら、クエストブックを見るといい。迷わぬよう、この地図も持っていくといい。
Fantastic Voyage#242.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#243.src: Give the Odd Stew to Relend.
Fantastic Voyage#243.dst: 妙なシチューを Relend に渡す。

Fantastic Voyage#244.src: Well, this stew has a rather odd flavor. But any food we can get here I shall savor.
Fantastic Voyage#244.dst: ふむ、このシチューはなんとも妙な味。だがここで食べられる物なら、何でも味わうのが私の流儀。
Fantastic Voyage#244.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#245.src: What remains of my ship won't protect us very well. We'll need to find shelter, as you can clearly tell.
Fantastic Voyage#245.dst: 我が船の残骸では、身を守るのに心もとない。見ての通り、隠れ家を探さねばならない。
Fantastic Voyage#245.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#246.src: To the east, I can just barely make out a tent. Go and look for my friend there. I'm simply hellbent!
Fantastic Voyage#246.dst: 東の方に、テントがかすかに見える。そこで我が友を探してくれ。私の決意は燃える！
Fantastic Voyage#246.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#247.src: Check out the tent to the east.

Fantastic Voyage#249.src: So the tent was all empty and run-down? All of this bad news is making me frown.
Fantastic Voyage#249.dst: テントは空っぽで荒れ果てていた？悪い知らせばかりで、眉をひそめてしまった。
Fantastic Voyage#249.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#250.src: Allow me to borrow your map for a second. We'll have to find him somewhere else, I reckon.
Fantastic Voyage#250.dst: 少しの間、君の地図を貸してくれ。どうやら別の場所で彼を探さねばならぬようだ、やれやれ。
Fantastic Voyage#250.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#251.src: I know we can come up with a solution using our wits. Perhaps we can use an explosive to blow that big rock to bits!
Fantastic Voyage#251.dst: 知恵を絞れば、解決策は見つかるはず。爆薬で、あの大岩を粉々にできるはず！
Fantastic Voyage#251.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#252.src: Let's think of some materials we can get here. There isn't much on this island, I fear...
Fantastic Voyage#252.dst: ここで手に入る材料を考えてみよう。この島にはあまり物がないようだ、どうしよう…
Fantastic Voyage#252.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#253.src: First we're going to need [{~} Gritty Sand]. Where to get it? Try the beach at the back of the island.
Fantastic Voyage#253.dst: まずは [{~} Gritty Sand] が必要だ。どこで手に入るか？島の裏の浜辺を探してみたまえ、さあ。
Fantastic Voyage#253.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#254.src: Next up is [Sawdust], you'll need three. I think the best place to search would be the largest tree.
Fantastic Voyage#254.dst: 次は [Sawdust]、三つ必要だ。探すなら一番大きな木がいいだろうな。
Fantastic Voyage#254.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#255.src: Finally, [{~} Black Powder], found in a place that is very unique. You'll have to brave your way to the volcano's peak.
Fantastic Voyage#255.dst: 最後に [{~} Black Powder]、とても珍しい場所にある。勇気を出して火山の頂上まで登る必要がある。
Fantastic Voyage#255.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#256.src: You'll need those items you craft the bomb, I just told you where to look. If you forget what you need to find, check your quest book.
Fantastic Voyage#256.dst: 必要な物と探す場所は、今伝えたとおり。忘れたら、クエストブックを開くのだ、いつもどおり。
Fantastic Voyage#256.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#257.src: Bring {~} Gritty Sand, {~} Saw Dust, and {~} Black Powder to the Crafting Table.
Fantastic Voyage#257.dst: {~} 個の Gritty Sand、{~} 個の Saw Dust、{~} 個の Black Powder を作業台に持っていく。

Fantastic Voyage#258.src: Use the explosive on the boulder.

Fantastic Voyage#259.src: Incredible, The explosive blew right through the stone!
Fantastic Voyage#259.dst: 素晴らしい、爆薬が岩を貫いた！
Fantastic Voyage#259.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#260.src: Let us progress into this mysterious zone.
Fantastic Voyage#260.dst: この謎の地へ、いざ踏み出した！
Fantastic Voyage#260.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#263.src: For adventurers like us, an incredible cave, perfect to explore.
Fantastic Voyage#263.dst: 我らのような冒険者には、探索にうってつけの見事な洞窟だ。
Fantastic Voyage#263.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#264.src: Surely where my old friend ventured - just as I swore!
Fantastic Voyage#264.dst: 我が旧友が挑んだのは、きっとここだ、誓った通りだ！
Fantastic Voyage#264.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#265.src: Long ago, a strong adventurer like yourself reached out to me for a wonderful sail. It truly is a gripping tale!
Fantastic Voyage#265.dst: 昔、君のような強い冒険者が、素晴らしい航海に誘ってくれた。実に手に汗握る物語だった！
Fantastic Voyage#265.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#266.src: We became best friends on our quest. But then he vanished, oh how he was the best.
Fantastic Voyage#266.dst: 旅の中で我らは親友となった。だが彼は消えた、ああ、最高の友だった。
Fantastic Voyage#266.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#267.src: And we've finally made it to where he'd been. I can't wait to see him again, I don't know where to begin!
Fantastic Voyage#267.dst: そしてついに、彼がいた場所に来た。また会えるのが待ちきれない、何から話そう、胸がいっぱいだ！
Fantastic Voyage#267.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#268.src: A mystical portal! This must be where my old friend got lost!
Fantastic Voyage#268.dst: 神秘の門だ！我が旧友はここで消えたに違いない！
Fantastic Voyage#268.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#269.src: We must go through and find him, whatever the cost.
Fantastic Voyage#269.dst: どんな犠牲を払っても、くぐって彼を見つけねばならない。
Fantastic Voyage#269.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#270.src: I can't believe it! I simply can't speak!
Fantastic Voyage#270.dst: 信じられない！言葉にならない！
Fantastic Voyage#270.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#271.src: I always told the others I wasn't a freak. Old friend, I'll look for you until the bitter end!
Fantastic Voyage#271.dst: 私は変人じゃないと、ずっと皆に言ってきた。旧友よ、最後の最後まで君を探そう、心に決めた！
Fantastic Voyage#271.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#272.src: Find Relend in the strange place
Fantastic Voyage#272.dst: 奇妙な場所で Relend を見つける

Fantastic Voyage#273.src: A foreign land filled with danger, to the brim...
Fantastic Voyage#273.dst: 危険に満ちた異郷の地、溢れんばかりに…
Fantastic Voyage#273.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#274.src: It must be where he vanished to, regardless of how grim.
Fantastic Voyage#274.dst: いかに陰惨でも、彼が消えた先はここに違いない、確かに。
Fantastic Voyage#274.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#275.src: My friend... Where do you think we are?
Fantastic Voyage#275.dst: 友よ…ここはどこだと思う？
Fantastic Voyage#275.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#276.src: Whatever it is, I feel that we're being overseen from afar.
Fantastic Voyage#276.dst: 何にせよ、遠くから見られている気がする、どうも。
Fantastic Voyage#276.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#277.src: With all this danger, I still hope my good friend is still okay.
Fantastic Voyage#277.dst: これほど危険でも、我が友の無事をまだ願っている。
Fantastic Voyage#277.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#278.src: My goodness! Keep your wits about, we may be in for a fray!
Fantastic Voyage#278.dst: なんと！気を引き締めろ、一戦交えることになりそうだ！
Fantastic Voyage#278.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#279.src: Aagh... New friend... are you there?
Fantastic Voyage#279.dst: うう…新しき友…そこにいるか？
Fantastic Voyage#279.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#280.src: Don't...give up... we must find him, I swear...
Fantastic Voyage#280.dst: 諦め…るな…彼を見つけねば、誓って…
Fantastic Voyage#280.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#281.src: I promise I'll find him, I'll do it, without a single scar!
Fantastic Voyage#281.dst: 必ず彼を見つける、やってみせる、傷ひとつ負わずに！
Fantastic Voyage#281.speaker: Relend
